newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU strengthens rules on protection against benzene.
newsitem.headline: EU strengthens rules on protection against benzene.

text.p: European Union social affairs ministers agreed new rules on Tuesday aimed at protecting workers from exposure to benzene, a cancer-causing chemical.
Benzene is a volatile liquid found in products such as coal tar and petroleum and it is used as a solvent and to make plastics.

The legislation, which must be approved by the European Parliament before final adoption, sets limits for exposure by workers to benzene, adding it to existing EU rules on protecting workers from carcinogens.
It would affect, for example, workers in the oil refinery sector or tanker drivers, EU officials said.
The text would also extend the scope of the existing rules by redefining carcinogens to include products such as cosmetics, medicinal preparations and pesticides.
